title: 第二十章锦衣卫办案四第二十一章锦衣卫办案五
content_zh:
高中探花的消息传回陋巷，整条巷子都沸腾了。王阿婆提着刚烤好的胡饼，李娘子捧着亲手绣的锦帕，张承业夫妇更是备了一桌好酒好菜，为萧琰庆贺。巷子里的街坊围着萧琰，你一言我一语，满是羡慕与祝福。萧琰看着眼前熟悉的面孔，心中满是温暖，他知道，这份荣耀，不仅属于自己，也属于所有支持他的人。
按照朝廷惯例，新科探花需入朝为官，授予翰林院编修一职，负责起草诏书、编撰史书。入职前，萧琰需进宫面圣，接受陛下的召见。
入宫那日，萧琰身着崭新的官服，怀着忐忑又激动的心情走进大殿。陛下坐在龙椅上，面容威严却带着几分温和：“萧琰，你在张承业案与沈家灭门案中，展现出过人的智慧与勇气，秋闱又高中探花，实属难得。如今授予你翰林院编修一职，望你日后在朝中，能坚守初心，清正廉洁，为朝廷效力，为百姓谋福。”
萧琰恭敬地跪地叩首：“臣谢陛下恩典！臣定当不负陛下所托，鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已！”
退出大殿后，吏部侍郎李大人特意留住萧琰，拍了拍他的肩膀：“萧贤侄，翰林院是个好地方，能接触到朝廷核心事务，你要多学多听多看，积累经验。若遇到困难，随时来找我。”
萧琰连忙拱手道谢：“多谢李大人提点，臣记下了。”
正式入职翰林院后，萧琰很快就适应了官场的节奏。他每天早早来到翰林院，整理文书、起草诏书，对待每一项工作都一丝不苟。翰林院的同僚们大多是文人出身，起初对这个因协助锦衣卫办案而声名鹊起的探花郎有些好奇，甚至带着几分偏见。但相处久了，他们发现萧琰为人谦和、学识渊博，对待工作认真负责，便渐渐放下了偏见，与他交好。
日子一天天过去，萧琰在翰林院的工作越来越得心应手，也得到了上司的赏识。本以为日子会这样平稳地过下去，可他没想到，入职仅三个月，一场新的风波就悄然向他袭来。
这年冬天，长安周边地区遭遇大雪灾，粮食减产，百姓们面临着断粮的危机。朝廷下令从长安的官粮库中调拨粮食，赈济受灾百姓。可就在调拨粮食的过程中，负责此事的官员却发现，官粮库中的粮食数量，比账目上记录的少了整整三成！
此事很快上报给了陛下，陛下震怒。长安官粮库是朝廷储备粮食的重要场所，粮食亏空三成，不仅会影响赈济灾民的工作，还可能引发百姓恐慌，甚至动摇朝廷的统治根基。陛下当即下令，命锦衣卫与户部联合调查此事，务必查明粮食亏空的原因，揪出幕后黑手。
而萧琰，因曾多次协助锦衣卫破案，且心思缜密、善于观察，被陛下特意指派，协助锦衣卫与户部调查此案。
接到旨意时，萧琰正在翰林院整理史书。他心中有些意外，也有些担忧。官粮库涉及朝廷重要储备，此案必定牵扯甚广，远比之前的张承业案和沈家灭门案复杂。但他没有犹豫，立刻放下手中的工作，前往锦衣卫北镇抚司，与负责此案的锦衣卫指挥使沈炼汇合。
沈炼是锦衣卫中的老将，为人正直，办案经验丰富，之前萧琰曾与他有过一面之缘。见到萧琰，沈炼开门见山：“萧编修，陛下命你协助我们调查粮库亏空案，想必你也清楚此案的重要性。目前我们已经初步调查，发现粮库的账目混乱，负责管理粮库的官员们说辞不一，此案恐怕不简单。”
萧琰点点头：“沈指挥使，我明白此案的严重性。不知目前我们掌握了哪些线索？”
沈炼递给萧琰一本厚厚的账目：“这是粮库近三年的账目，我们初步核对，发现每年都有部分粮食去向不明，而且账目上的记录存在多处涂改痕迹。负责管理粮库的是户部郎中赵德，我们已经传讯过他，可他一口咬定账目无误，粮食减少是因为储存不当、受潮发霉，还拿出了一些所谓的‘损耗记录’。”
萧琰接过账目，仔细翻阅起来。果然，账目中有很多地方的数字被涂改过，而且“损耗记录”上的签名笔迹潦草，看起来很可疑。“沈指挥使，我觉得赵德在撒谎。储存不当导致粮食损耗是正常的，但损耗率不可能这么高，而且账目涂改痕迹明显，‘损耗记录’也很可能是伪造的。我们必须进一步调查赵德，以及粮库的其他官员。”
沈炼认同地说：“我也是这么想的。不过赵德在户部任职多年，根基深厚，背后可能有人撑腰，我们调查他，恐怕会遇到阻力。而且粮库的其他官员，要么与赵德串通一气，要么害怕被报复，不敢说实话，想要从他们口中套出真相，不容易。”
萧琰皱起眉头，陷入了沉思。他知道，沈炼说得有道理。官粮库亏空案涉及到户部官员，很可能还牵扯到更高层级的官员，想要查清此案，必须小心谨慎，找到确凿的证据。
“沈指挥使，不如我们先从粮库的底层人员入手？”萧琰突然开口，“粮库的看守、搬运工这些底层人员，他们虽然职位低微，但每天都在粮库工作，对粮库的情况最了解。或许他们知道一些内幕，只是因为害怕被报复而不敢说。我们可以想办法接近他们，让他们放下顾虑，说出真相。”
沈炼眼前一亮：“这个主意好！底层人员没有太多的利益牵扯，也没有那么多的顾虑，只要我们能保证他们的安全，或许他们真的能提供重要线索。事不宜迟，我们现在就去粮库，接触那些底层人员。”

萧琰与沈炼带着几名锦衣卫，乔装成粮商，来到了长安官粮库。粮库位于长安城的东郊，占地面积广阔，四周有高墙环绕，门口有官兵把守，戒备森严。
他们先是在粮库附近的茶馆坐下，观察着粮库的情况。茶馆里坐了不少人，大多是与粮库有生意往来的粮商，或是粮库的底层工作人员。萧琰注意到，角落里坐着一个中年男子，面色憔悴，独自喝着闷酒，看起来心事重重。从他的穿着和言谈举止来看，很可能是粮库的工作人员。
萧琰端着酒杯，慢慢走到中年男子身边，坐下笑道：“这位兄台，独自一人喝酒，可是有什么烦心事？”
中年男子抬头看了萧琰一眼，眼中带着几分警惕：“你是谁？我们认识吗？”
“在下是外地来的粮商，想在长安做些粮食生意，今日来粮库附近看看情况。”萧琰笑着说，“见兄台面带愁容，想必是遇到了什么难事，若是不嫌弃，不妨和在下说说，或许在下能帮上一点小忙。”
中年男子犹豫了一下，看了看萧琰，又看了看周围，见没人注意他们，才压低声音说：“唉，别提了。我在粮库做看守，最近粮库出了大事，粮食亏空了三成，朝廷正在调查。赵郎中把责任都推到我们这些底层人员身上，说我们看管不力，还威胁我们，若是敢乱说话，就把我们抓起来治罪。我们真是有苦说不出啊！”
萧琰心中一喜，知道自己找对人了。“兄台，你是说，粮食亏空不是因为看管不力，而是赵德在撒谎？”
中年男子点点头，声音更低了：“何止是撒谎！我在粮库做了五年看守，每年都有好几次，夜里有人偷偷把粮食运出粮库，赵郎中对此视而不见，还帮他们掩盖。那些运出去的粮食，恐怕就是导致粮库亏空的原因。”
“你知道那些粮食运到哪里去了吗？是谁指使的？”萧琰连忙追问。
中年男子摇了摇头：“我不知道具体运到哪里去了，每次运粮食的人都蒙着脸，而且行事非常隐秘。不过我曾无意中听到赵郎中与人谈话，提到过‘王大人’，说要把粮食‘交给王大人’。至于这个‘王大人’是谁，我就不知道了。”
萧琰与沈炼交换了一个眼神，都从对方眼中看到了一丝凝重。这个“王大人”，很可能就是此案的幕后黑手。
“兄台，多谢你告诉我们这些。”萧琰从怀中掏出一锭银子，递给中年男子，“这点银子你拿着，算是在下的一点心意。你放心，我们会保证你的安全，不会让赵德伤害你。”
中年男子连忙推辞：“不行不行，我不能要你的银子。我告诉你这些，只是因为我实在看不惯赵德的所作所为，也不想被他冤枉。只要你们能查清真相，还我们这些底层人员一个清白，我就心满意足了。”
萧琰看着中年男子真诚的眼神，心中十分感动。他收回银子，说道：“兄台放心，我们一定会查清此案，还你和其他底层人员一个清白。你以后在粮库也要多加小心，若是发现什么异常情况，随时联系我们。”他说着，递给中年男子一块锦衣卫的令牌，“拿着这个，若是遇到危险，可以凭此令牌找锦衣卫求助。”
中年男子接过令牌，感激地点点头：“多谢二位！”
content_en:
The news of the high school's top pick spread back to the back alley, and the whole alley was in a state of excitement. Grandma Wang was holding freshly baked Hu cakes, Madam Li was holding a brocade handkerchief embroidered by her own hands, and Zhang Chengye and his wife prepared a table of fine wine and food to celebrate Xiao Yan. The neighbors in the alley surrounded Xiao Yan, and their words to each other were filled with envy and blessings. Xiao Yan looked at the familiar faces in front of him, and his heart was filled with warmth. He knew that this honor not only belonged to himself, but also to all those who supported him.
According to the court's practice, Xinke Tanhua was required to enter the court as an official and be granted the post of editor of the Hanlin Academy, responsible for drafting imperial edicts and compiling history books. Before taking up the post, Xiao Yan had to go to the palace to meet the Holy Emperor and accept His Majesty's summons.
On the day of entering the palace, Xiao Yan wore a brand new official uniform and walked into the hall with anxiety and excitement. His Majesty is sitting on the throne, with a majestic but gentle face: "Xiao Yan, you have shown extraordinary wisdom and courage in the Zhang Chengye case and the Shen family extermination case. It is rare for you to be the top student in high school in autumn. Now that you are awarded the position of editor of the Hanlin Academy, I hope that in the future in the court, you can stick to your original intention, be honest, serve the court, and benefit the people."
Xiao Yan knelt down and kowtowed respectfully: "I thank Your Majesty for your grace! I will live up to Your Majesty's trust, devote myself to death, and die!"
After exiting the main hall, Mr. Li, the Minister of Civil Affairs, deliberately kept Xiao Yan and patted him on the shoulder: "Xiao Xian's nephew, the Hanlin Academy is a good place where you can get in touch with the core affairs of the imperial court. You should learn more, listen more, watch more, and accumulate experience. If you encounter difficulties, come to me at any time."
Xiao Yan quickly raised his hands and thanked him: "Thank you, Mr. Li, for the tip. I'll take note of it."
After officially joining the Hanlin Academy, Xiao Yan quickly adapted to the rhythm of officialdom. He came to the Hanlin Academy early every day to organize documents and draft edicts, and he was meticulous in every work. Most of the colleagues in the Hanlin Academy came from literary backgrounds. At first, they were a little curious and even a little prejudiced about this Tanhualang, who became famous for assisting Jin Yiwei in handling cases. But after getting along for a long time, they found that Xiao Yan was modest, knowledgeable, and took his work seriously and responsibly, so they gradually put aside their prejudices and became good friends with him.
As the days passed, Xiao Yan became more and more comfortable at work in the Hanlin Academy, and was appreciated by his superiors. He thought that life would go on smoothly like this, but he didn't expect that just three months after joining the company, a new crisis quietly hit him.
This winter, areas around Chang'an suffered from heavy snowstorms, which reduced food production and the people faced the crisis of running out of food. The imperial court ordered the allocation of grain from the official grain depot in Chang'an to provide relief to the people affected by the disaster. But during the process of allocating grain, the official in charge discovered that the amount of grain in the official grain warehouse was a full 30% less than what was recorded in the accounts!
The matter was quickly reported to His Majesty, who was furious. The Chang'an Official Grain Depot was an important place for the imperial court to reserve grain. A 30% deficit in grain would not only affect the work of relieving victims, but may also cause panic among the people and even shake the foundation of the imperial court's rule. His Majesty immediately ordered the Jin Yiwei and the Ministry of Household Affairs to jointly investigate the matter. They must find out the cause of the food shortage and find out the mastermind behind it.
As for Xiao Yan, because he had assisted Jin Yiwei in solving crimes many times and was thoughtful and observant, he was specially assigned by His Majesty to assist Jin Yiwei and the Ministry of Household Affairs in investigating the case.
When he received the order, Xiao Yan was sorting out history books in the Hanlin Academy. He was a little surprised and worried. The official grain warehouse involves important reserves of the imperial court, so this case must be very involved and far more complicated than the previous Zhang Chengye case and the Shen family extermination case. But he did not hesitate and immediately put down his work and went to Fusi, Jinyiwei North Town, to meet up with Shen Lian, the Jinyiwei commander in charge of the case.
Shen Lian is a veteran of the Jinyi Guards. He is an upright man and has rich experience in handling cases. Xiao Yan had met him once before. Seeing Xiao Yan, Shen Lian got straight to the point: "Editor Xiao, your Majesty ordered you to assist us in investigating the grain depot deficit case. I believe you also know the importance of this case. At present, we have made a preliminary investigation and found outThe accounts of the current grain depot are in confusion, and the officials responsible for managing the grain depot have different opinions. I am afraid this case is not simple. "
Xiao Yan nodded: "Commander Shen, I understand the seriousness of this case. I wonder what clues we have so far? "
Shen Lian handed Xiao Yan a thick account: "These are the accounts of the grain depot for the past three years. After preliminary verification, we found that some grains go unaccounted for every year, and there are many traces of alteration in the records on the accounts. The person in charge of managing the grain depot is Zhao De, a doctor from the Ministry of Revenue. We have already summoned him, but he insists that the accounts are correct. The decrease in grain is due to improper storage, moisture and mold, and he also produced some so-called 'loss records'. "
Xiao Yan took the account and read it carefully. Sure enough, the numbers in many places in the accounts had been altered, and the signatures on the "loss records" were scrawled, which looked suspicious. "Commander Shen, I think Zhao De is lying. It is normal for food to be lost due to improper storage, but the loss rate cannot be so high, and there are obvious traces of tampering with the accounts, and the 'loss record' is also likely to be forged. We must further investigate Zhao De and other officials at the grain depot. "
Shen Lian agreed and said, "I think so too. However, Zhao De has served in the Ministry of Household Affairs for many years and has a deep foundation. There may be people behind him. If we investigate him, we may encounter resistance. Moreover, other officials at the grain depot were either colluding with Zhao De or were afraid of being retaliated and did not dare to tell the truth. It was not easy to get the truth out of them. "
Xiao Yan frowned and fell into deep thought. He knew that what Shen Lian said made sense. The official grain depot deficit case involves officials from the Ministry of Revenue, and may also involve higher-level officials. If you want to investigate this case, you must be careful and find conclusive evidence.
"Commander Shen, why don't we start with the lower-level personnel of the grain depot? Xiao Yan suddenly said, "The guards and porters of the grain depot and other low-level personnel, although they have low-level positions, work in the grain depot every day and know the situation of the grain depot best." Maybe they know something inside, but are afraid to tell it for fear of retaliation. We can find ways to get close to them so that they can put aside their concerns and tell the truth. "
Shen Lian's eyes lit up: "This is a good idea! The people at the bottom don't have too many interests involved, and they don't have that many worries. As long as we can ensure their safety, maybe they can really provide important clues. Without further ado, let’s go to the grain depot now and get in touch with those at the bottom. "
Xiao Yan and Shen Lian took several Jinyi guards, disguised as grain merchants, to the Chang'an official grain depot. The grain depot is located in the eastern suburbs of Chang'an City. It covers a vast area and is surrounded by high walls. The entrance is guarded by officers and soldiers and is heavily guarded.
They first sat down in a teahouse near the grain depot and observed the situation in the grain depot. There were many people sitting in the teahouse, most of them were grain merchants who had business dealings with the grain depot, or low-level staff of the grain depot. Xiao Yan noticed that there was a middle-aged man sitting in the corner with a haggard face, drinking alone and looking very worried. Judging from his dress and mannerisms, he was probably a staff member of the grain depot.
Xiao Yan held the wine glass, walked slowly to the middle-aged man, sat down and said with a smile: "Brother, you are drinking alone, but what is there to worry about? "
The middle-aged man raised his head and glanced at Xiao Yan, with a bit of vigilance in his eyes: "Who are you? Do we know each other? "
"I am a grain merchant from out of town who wants to do some grain business in Chang'an. I came to the grain depot today to check out the situation. Xiao Yan said with a smile, "I see that my brother is looking sad. He must have encountered some difficulty. If you don't mind, you might as well talk to me. Maybe I can help you a little." "
The middle-aged man hesitated for a moment, looked at Xiao Yan, then looked around, and when he saw that no one was paying attention to them, he lowered his voice and said, "Oh, don't mention it. I work as a guard at the grain depot. Something big happened recently. The grain shortage was 30%. The court is investigating. Zhao LangThe Central Committee put all the responsibility on us, the lower-level people, saying that we were not in good enough custody, and threatened us that if we dared to talk nonsense, we would be arrested and punished. We really have troubles that we can’t express! "
Xiao Yan felt happy, knowing that she had found the right person. "Brother, are you saying that the food shortage is not because of poor supervision, but because Zhao De is lying? "
The middle-aged man nodded and said in a lower voice: "It's more than just lying! I have been a guard at the grain depot for five years. Several times every year, someone secretly transports grain out of the grain depot at night. Doctor Zhao turns a blind eye to this and helps them cover it up. The grain shipped out may be the reason for the shortage of grain depots. "
"Do you know where the food went? Who instigated it? "Xiao Yan asked quickly.
The middle-aged man shook his head: "I don't know exactly where it was transported. Every time the people transporting food, their faces are covered, and they act very secretly. However, I once overheard Doctor Zhao talking to someone, mentioning ‘Master Wang’ and saying that he would ‘give the grain to Master Wang’. As for who this ‘Lord Wang’ is, I don’t know. "
Xiao Yan and Shen Lian exchanged glances, and both saw a hint of solemnity in each other's eyes. This "Master Wang" is probably the mastermind behind this case.
"Brother, thank you for telling us this. "Xiao Yan took out a piece of silver from his pocket and handed it to the middle-aged man, "You can take this little silver as a token of my gratitude. Don't worry, we will ensure your safety and won't let Zhao De hurt you. "
The middle-aged man quickly declined: "No, no, I can't ask for your money. I'm telling you this just because I really can't stand what Zhao De has done, and I don't want to be wronged by him. As long as you can find out the truth and restore innocence to those of us at the bottom, I will be satisfied. "
Xiao Yan looked at the middle-aged man's sincere eyes and was very moved. He took back the money and said, "Don't worry, brother, we will definitely investigate this case and clear your name and the innocence of other low-level people. You should also be more careful in the grain depot in the future. If you find anything abnormal, please contact us at any time. "He said, handing the middle-aged man a Jinyiwei token, "Take this, if you are in danger, you can use this token to ask Jinyiwei for help. "
The middle-aged man took the token and nodded gratefully: "Thank you both! "
